title: What each transitivity screen can see
question: Do the available transitivity screens (covariate dissimilarity, loop inconsistency, heterogeneity), run together, detect the violations that bias a network estimate, and can their pattern of flags identify the mechanism?
design: Triangle networks with two or five studies per comparison and five violation mechanisms, including a loop-consistent unmeasured modifier constructed to be invisible to every screen; 26 cells, 2000 replicates each; detection, bias, coverage and mechanism identification.
